## Exact versions

GraphBridge / EF Core / Neo4j.Driver / .NET / Neo4j version and edition:

## Expected EF behavior

Link the EF documentation or exact upstream test class/method. State whether this is a general EF contract or relational-provider behavior.

## Reproduction

Include synthetic entities/configuration, seed, LINQ/save operation, tracking mode, transaction scope and expected versus actual entity/graph state. If comparing another provider, name its version and fixture.

## Translation and diagnostics

Include generated Cypher when available and sanitized exception/log details. Remove credentials, connection environment files and application parameter values. Link the current GraphBridge support/limitations entry and distinguish unsupported-operation rejection from incorrect supported behavior.
